title: Photo Duo 042 · USSBBW × 텐트폴 USSBBW · 둘 다 걸터앉기
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A photograph of TWO women seated side by side on one short backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, just long enough for the two of them and no longer, in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth deep-charcoal wall behind them, the camera set close at bench level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, seated with their knees apart and their feet flat on the floor, their two bodies together overflowing the stone on both sides and filling the frame from edge to edge, their hips and sides pressed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman: a Black woman in her late 40s, deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, not brown, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body, a wide round afro with a gold headband. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in three or four heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. A gigantic bust above it, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders and an enormous rounded rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, very thick upper arms. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with iridescent mother-of-pearl vines, peonies and cranes in pink, aqua and silver, wide bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines.

Right woman: a Scandinavian woman in her late 20s, very fair skin with cool pink undertones and faint freckling, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a high top knot with loose strands. A giant hourglass frame flaring out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, huge thick arms pushed far out by the width of her back, a colossal bust projecting past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders and a huge rounded rear; the muscle is rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Korean celadon inlay — a pale jade-green glaze ground inlaid with indigo and black cranes, clouds and chrysanthemum medallions, fine dark bands following every curve, the glaze staying pale.

Their outer hands rest on the stone beside their hips, their inner hands on their own thighs. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation photograph, taller than it is wide.
